3 September
On this day in 1922

Sardar Bhagat Singh of village Todha Khurad and his two sons, Sardar Tara Singh and Sardar Asa Singh

Were badly tortured for suspicion of their sympathic views regarding Guru-Ka-Bagh Morcha. As a result, Sardar Bhagat Singh died on Sep. 4 and Sardar Tara Singh died on Sep. 6, 1922.

Also on this day

  • 1708Madho Dass Baeragi was baptised and became Banda Singh Bahadur
  • 1965Fateh Singh declared that Punjabi Suba was more dear to him than India
